core\utils\media\manifest.ts

Runtime knowledge of which CDN objects exist, backed by the
Sourcesrc/core\utils\media\manifest.ts
UX surfaceShared primitives every surface builds on — no direct UI.

Members

keys

Parsed bucket key set — null until (or unless) the manifest fetch lands.

pending

In-flight fetch dedupe — multiple boot callers share one request.

initMediaManifest

Fetches the bucket key manifest once; resolves immediately on repeat calls. Fire-and-forget at boot — renders that happen before it lands simply emit no , which is the safe path.

mediaManifestReady

Whether the manifest has arrived. Lets the media-figure probe distinguish "unknown — try webp" from "known-absent — skip straight to the original".

mediaKeyExists

Whether the manifest lists the CDN object behind url. Absolute URLs get the CDN_BASE prefix stripped to their bucket key; non-CDN URLs (gravatars, data URIs) always report false — they have no siblings.

  • @param url Full media URL or a raw bucket key.

webpIfExists

webp sibling of a .jpg URL when the manifest confirms it was generated, '' otherwise — safe srcset input for a : empty means "no source".

  • @param url Original .jpg media URL.

webmIfExists

webm sibling of an .mp4 URL when it exists in the manifest, '' otherwise. <video><source> DOES retry the next source on network failure, so this gate is belt-and-suspenders for saving a doomed request, not correctness.

  • @param url Original .mp4 media URL.

(module scope)

One proven rung on a progressive-cover quality ladder — the jpg URL plus its webp sibling ('' when the manifest can't prove it).

jpg

Proven .jpg variant URL for the tier.

webp

Proven .webp sibling, '' when the manifest can't prove it.

(module scope)

Manifest-gated cover URL matrix — see coverVariants().

src

URL for the LQIP — kodak blur thumb when proven, else the original.

webp

webp matching src, '' when not proven.

mobileJpg

≤768px LQIP jpg for a media-scoped , '' when not proven.

mobileWebp

≤768px LQIP webp — preferred over mobileJpg when both exist.

rungs

Ascending display-quality rungs the high layer climbs (coverLadderStep walks them, highest proven quality last) — empty when no LQIP exists, since src is then already the original.

LADDER_SUFFIXES

Ascending quality-tier suffixes for a cover ladder — q50 → q75 → the raw original → uncompressed, mirroring the build-time IMAGE_VARIANTS quality order in shared/scripts/build/media-manifest.mjs (uncompressed pass preferred, then raw original). The '' entry is the original URL.

coverRungs

Builds the ascending upgrade ladder for one covers/<stem>.jpg URL — every derivative rung is mediaKeyExists-proven so a swapped-in src can never 404; the original row ('' suffix) is always trusted because it IS the URL the database points at. Non-.jpg input keeps its stem whole and resolves to just the passthrough original rung.

  • @param stemJpg Emission-encoded media URL ending in .jpg (original).
  • @returns Ascending rungs — lowest quality first, highest last.

mediaRungs

Fully manifest-gated quality ladder for an extensionless media stem (folder/pic — the figure/video grammar where derived files are stem-mozjpg-<quality>.jpg). Unlike coverRungs even the raw {stem}.jpg is proven by mediaKeyExists — the pipeline emits only suffixed tiers, so an untrusted passthrough could 404. Returns [] when the manifest is absent or proves nothing; callers then fall back to the historic "the request IS the check" probe.

  • @param stem Emission-encoded media URL without an extension.
  • @returns Ascending proven rungs — lowest quality first, highest last.

coverVariants

Resolves the progressive cover matrix for one covers/<stem>.jpg URL: the kodak LQIP blur-up (plus its 768px mobile tier and webp siblings) as the first paint, and rungs as the ascending quality ladder the high layer climbs once bytes confirm — q50 → q75 → original → uncompressed, highest proven tier last. Every variant is gated on mediaKeyExists so an unproven object can never become a card's only image; a missing/never-loaded manifest yields the original URL with its own webp probe and no ladder (rungs stays empty).

  • @param coverJpg Emission-encoded covers/*.jpg URL (original).
  • @returns Bound URLs for picture/img — empty strings mean "omit".
